from src.portfolio.base_portfolio import POSITIONS
from src.portfolio.pricing_models import price_portfolio
from src.portfolio.data_access import load_all_risk_factors

factors = load_all_risk_factors()
market = {name: s.iloc[-1] for name, s in factors.items()}
market['di_pre'] = market['di_pre'] * (1 + 0.01)
shocked_value = sum(price_portfolio(POSITIONS, market).values())
